title: backendomy
tagline: Building tooling to go from Privy and Biconomy to server-side AA execution
description: Introduced file storage alternative to the current Biconomy local storage session key approach. Was not able to finish e2e but was able to submit a pull request for the backend. Instead of local storage keys, get stored as JSON structure while respecting the current standards. The same approach can be easily extrapolated to custom database solutions. Session keys offer a robust use case for building transactions more web2-like. Existing local storage solutions don't favor approaches for backend only or native mobile app development.
